property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner and any candidate newOwner, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) updates C.owner() to exactly the supplied newOwner; the mutant instead sets owner to address(0) and so will violate this whenever newOwner != address(0).
change_summary: Replace the assignment 'owner = _newOwner;' with assignment to the zero address, so owner becomes address(0) instead of the provided _newOwner.
